assertions.description: The base Self-Profiling API's Profiler constructor is exposed on Window.
On this route (served with Document-Policy: js-profiling) a real Profiler can be constructed and stopped.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ try { const p = new Profiler({ sampleInterval: 10, maxBufferSize: 100 }); await p.stop(); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: A stopped trace exposes the spec's samples/stacks/frames arrays with timestamped samples.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ try { const p = new Profiler({ sampleInterval: 10, maxBufferSize: 1000 }); const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 60) Math.sqrt(Math.random()); const tr = await p.stop(); return Array.isArray(tr.samples) && Array.isArray(tr.stacks) && Array.isArray(tr.frames) && tr.samples.length > 0 && typeof tr.samples[0].timestamp === 'number'; } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: When samples carry a marker member, every value belongs to the proposed ProfilerMarker enum (script, gc, style, layout, paint, other) — unknown vocabulary must not appear. Passes vacuously only on engines that expose markers; on pre-marker engines the marked count is zero and the assertion returns false to record the absence.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ try { const p = new Profiler({ sampleInterval: 10, maxBufferSize: 2000 }); const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 120) { document.body.style.setProperty('--conf-x', String(Math.random())); void document.body.offsetWidth; } const tr = await p.stop(); const marked = tr.samples.filter((s) => 'marker' in s); if (marked.length === 0) return false; const allowed = new Set(['script','gc','style','layout','paint','other']); return marked.every((s) => allowed.has(s.marker)); } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: The marker member is [CrossOriginIsolated]: on a non-isolated page no sample may carry a marker even on an implementing engine.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (window.crossOriginIsolated) return true; try { const p = new Profiler({ sampleInterval: 10, maxBufferSize: 500 }); const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 60) Math.sqrt(Math.random()); const tr = await p.stop(); return tr.samples.every((s) => !('marker' in s)); } catch (e) { return false; } })()

assertions.description: On a cross-origin isolated page in Chrome 153 with the feature, induced style/layout/paint work produces samples whose marker names the activity.
assertions.test: Requires a COOP+COEP isolated origin on Chrome 153: run the live-trace-explorer workload and verify style/layout/paint markers appear in the histogram.
